preserved: Original designer file is byte-identical: 1427x842 host, 450x571 view_frame and original controls, text, grouping, QSS, Password echo and tab order.
Original empty password ignores username and remember checkbox, returning to Guest without changing default accounts.
Nonempty credentials match both name and pwd using bound SQL. Roles 0 through 5 retain their existing meaning.
Remember only applies to successful nonempty credentials with role at most Engineer (4); Administrator (5) does not change defaults.
Default update still clears prior flags and marks all records with the authenticated username, retaining the existing duplicate-name CRUD semantics.
Failure retains the previous identity and the masked input. Escape remains consumed and does not dismiss login.
Existing setSession simulation and account CRUD APIs/signals remain intact. Authentication never changes actionReady.
intentional_differences: Authentication and default-name reads run in the existing AccountStore worker; dedicated request-id signals avoid polluting the hidden account CRUD page.
The login dialog and its original shared warning card use asynchronous open. Pending requests and visible warnings block close/repeated submit; old request replies cannot change a reopened dialog.

The original credential query returns its first row without an ordering guarantee. Matching multiple identical name-and-password rows now fails explicitly instead of selecting an arbitrary identity or role.
Default username prefill uses ORDER BY id LIMIT 1, matching the deterministic order of the current account snapshots; the reference query did not specify order.
Default flag updates are transactional. Failure rolls back the previous flags while the verified login still succeeds with a separate warning.
The original username validator ^[A-Za-z0-9].{16}$ and its Intermediate submission behavior are retained; no new length policy is imposed.
The existing public account-page button colors are reused: normal 42,118,242,255; hover 42,118,242,170; pressed 135,206,250,255. No runtime reference theme/configuration is read.
The original dynamic company title comes from theme/name, whose active value has not been supplied. The designer label remains empty rather than guessing a brand title.

The shared mask positions the original card relative to the current host, without the reference global mainWinPtr. Linux missing-font fallback and original active Windows theme remain separately pending.
data_scope: Only explicit isolated anonymous account directories. Existing directories are reopened without seeding or resetting. The original pwd VARCHAR storage remains direct text; this is not a completed production credential security design.
secrets: Transient test credentials are generated at runtime. No password text, authentication DB, authentication DB digest or password-derived digest belongs in public evidence. Dialog fields are cleared on final close/destruction.
